scenes.text: This tutorial covers Home screen and navigation. Tour the application, its module groups, run summaries, maturity indicators, and navigation controls.
Open Home screen and navigation from the Home section. Launch the spaCR desktop application and begin on Home.
In the main configuration area, use the sidebar, category tabs, searchable app tiles, and command palette to reach a workflow.

Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. Open a module only when you intend to interact with it; the pointer is shown only for real clicks.
When the workflow finishes, you can move through the application and understand the status information shown on Home.
